# Private Note Capital

> A data and education platform for private-debt and foreclosure-auction real estate opportunities in California and Florida. It brings together property data, investor education, and private-debt deal information in one place. Informational only.

Private Note Capital is an information and research platform operated by Anatoliy Kanevsky, based in the Los Angeles area. It covers private-debt (trust-deed and note) opportunities, foreclosure-auction data and due-diligence guidance, and investor education across California and Florida. It is a resource for learning and research, not a securities offering.

- Coverage: California and Florida
- Contact: 310-686-5053 · Los Angeles area
- This is not an offer or solicitation of securities, and not investment, legal, or tax advice. Content is informational only; see the terms and privacy pages.

- [Review](https://privatenotecapital.com/private-debt/review): How opportunities are reviewed.
